flags.why: Rỉa rói means to nag or make persistent cutting remarks, not to peck or nibble ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-r%E1%BB%89a%20r%C3%B3i)).
flags.fix: to nag; to make persistent cutting remarks

flags.why: The example incorrectly uses rỉa rói for birds feeding rather than persistent verbal criticism ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-r%E1%BB%89a%20r%C3%B3i)).
flags.fix: Anh ấy cứ rỉa rói tôi suốt ngày. = He keeps making cutting remarks at me all day.

flags.why: In cười rộ, rộ describes laughter erupting collectively, rather than an adjective meaning noisy or loud ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-r%E1%BB%99)).
flags.fix: all together; in a collective burst (as in cười rộ, to burst out laughing together)
